title: Weather & Seasons (天气与季节)
description: Talk about weather and seasons in Mandarin: the four seasons, weather words like 下雨 and 刮风, temperature with 度 (dù), asking with 怎么样, and saying which season you like best.

notes.heading: 📌 The Four Seasons (季节)
notes.body:
A season is 季节 (jìjié). All four season words end in 天 (tiān, day/sky):

| Chinese | Pinyin | English |
|---|---|---|
| 春天 | chūntiān | spring |
| 夏天 | xiàtiān | summer |
| 秋天 | qiūtiān | autumn |
| 冬天 | dōngtiān | winter |

The characters 春夏秋冬 (chūn xià qiū dōng) alone mean spring, summer, autumn, winter.

Example: 一年有四个季节。 (Yì nián yǒu sì ge jìjié.) — A year has four seasons.

notes.heading: 📌 Weather Words (天气)
notes.body:
Weather is 天气 (tiānqì). Learn these common weather words:

| Chinese | Pinyin | English |
|---|---|---|
| 晴天 | qíngtiān | sunny day |
| 阴天 | yīntiān | overcast day |
| 多云 | duōyún | cloudy |
| 下雨 | xià yǔ | to rain |
| 下雪 | xià xuě | to snow |
| 刮风 | guā fēng | to be windy (wind blows) |

雨 (yǔ) is rain, 雪 (xuě) is snow, 风 (fēng) is wind, 云 (yún) is cloud.

- 今天是晴天。 (Jīntiān shì qíngtiān.) — Today is a sunny day.
- 昨天下雨了。 (Zuótiān xià yǔ le.) — It rained yesterday.

notes.heading: 📌 Temperature: 度, 冷 and 热
notes.body:
Degrees are 度 (dù). To say the temperature, use number + 度:

- 今天三十度。 (Jīntiān sānshí dù.) — It is thirty degrees today.
- 零下五度 (língxià wǔ dù) — five degrees below zero.

How hot or cold it feels:

| Chinese | Pinyin | English |
|---|---|---|
| 冷 | lěng | cold |
| 热 | rè | hot |
| 凉快 | liángkuai | pleasantly cool |
| 暖和 | nuǎnhuo | warm |

To ask the temperature: 今天多少度? (Jīntiān duōshao dù?) — How many degrees is it today?

Example: 冬天很冷，夏天很热。 (Dōngtiān hěn lěng, xiàtiān hěn rè.) — Winter is very cold; summer is very hot.

notes.heading: 🔑 Asking with 怎么样 and 怎么
notes.body:
怎么样 (zěnmeyàng) means "how is it / what is it like" and 怎么 (zěnme) means "how".

- 今天天气怎么样? (Jīntiān tiānqì zěnmeyàng?) — How is the weather today?
- 北京的冬天怎么样? (Běijīng de dōngtiān zěnmeyàng?) — What is Beijing's winter like?

Answer by describing it: 今天天气很好，不冷也不热。 (Jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo, bù lěng yě bú rè.) — The weather today is great, neither cold nor hot.

🔑 How it works: 怎么样 usually comes at the END of the question (after the topic), while 怎么 comes BEFORE a verb: 这个字怎么写? (How do you write this character?)

notes.heading: 🔑 Talking About Future Weather: 会 (huì)
notes.body:
会 (huì) means "will / is likely to" and is used for weather forecasts.

Pattern: time + 会 + weather verb.

- 明天会下雨。 (Míngtiān huì xià yǔ.) — It will rain tomorrow.
- 后天会下雪吗? (Hòutiān huì xià xuě ma?) — Will it snow the day after tomorrow?

⚠️ Common mistake: 会 also means "can / know how to" (我会游泳 — I can swim). In weather sentences it means "will", not "can" — rain does not have skills!

notes.heading: 🔑 Comparing Weather in Different Places
notes.body:
Use 比 (bǐ, than) to compare the weather in two places, and 跟...一样 (gēn... yíyàng) to say two places are the same.

- 北京比伦敦冷。 (Běijīng bǐ Lúndūn lěng.) — Beijing is colder than London.
- 上海的夏天比北京热。 (Shànghǎi de xiàtiān bǐ Běijīng rè.) — Shanghai's summer is hotter than Beijing's.
- 这里的天气跟那里一样。 (Zhèli de tiānqì gēn nàli yíyàng.) — The weather here is the same as there.

To say "not as... as", use 没有: 这里没有北京冷。 (Zhèli méiyǒu Běijīng lěng.) — It is not as cold here as in Beijing.

notes.heading: 💡 Saying Which Season You Like
notes.body:
Combine seasons, weather and reasons to give your opinion. The reason word is 因为 (yīnwèi, because).

Model paragraph:

我最喜欢秋天，因为天气不冷也不热，很凉快。春天常常下雨，夏天太热，冬天会下雪，很冷。你最喜欢哪个季节?

(Wǒ zuì xǐhuan qiūtiān, yīnwèi tiānqì bù lěng yě bú rè, hěn liángkuai. Chūntiān chángcháng xià yǔ, xiàtiān tài rè, dōngtiān huì xià xuě, hěn lěng. Nǐ zuì xǐhuan nǎ ge jìjié?)

"I like autumn the most, because the weather is neither cold nor hot — pleasantly cool. In spring it often rains, summer is too hot, and in winter it snows and is very cold. Which season do you like the most?"

Useful pattern: 你最喜欢哪个季节? (Nǐ zuì xǐhuan nǎ ge jìjié?) — Which season do you like most? 哪个 (nǎ ge) means "which".

✅ Check: can you describe today's weather, compare two cities, and name your favourite season with a reason?

flashcards.example: 春天天气暖和。 — The weather in spring is warm.
冬天会下雪。 — It snows in winter.
外面下雨了。 — It is raining outside.
昨天夜里下雪了。 — It snowed last night.

flashcards.definition: to be windy; the wind blows
flashcards.example: 今天刮风，有一点儿冷。 — It is windy today and a bit cold.
明天多云，不下雨。 — Tomorrow will be cloudy, but it will not rain.
今天二十五度。 — It is twenty-five degrees today.
北京的冬天很冷。 — Beijing's winter is very cold.
夏天很热，我想去游泳。 — Summer is hot; I want to go swimming.

flashcards.definition: how is it; what is it like
flashcards.example: 今天天气怎么样? — How is the weather today?

flashcards.definition: will; is likely to (also: can, know how to)
flashcards.example: 明天会下雨。 — It will rain tomorrow.
我最喜欢秋天，因为天气很凉快。 — I like autumn most because the weather is pleasantly cool.

questions.explanation: 冬 (dōng) means winter, so 冬天 (dōngtiān) is winter. Summer is 夏天 and spring is 春天.
雨 (yǔ) is rain and 下 (xià) means to fall, so 下雨 means to rain. Snow uses 雪 instead: 下雪.

questions.stem: 今天天气怎么样? What is being asked?
questions.explanation: 天气 (tiānqì) is weather and 怎么样 (zěnmeyàng) asks "how is it", so the question asks how the weather is today.

questions.stem: 明天会下雨。 What does this sentence mean?
questions.explanation: In weather forecasts 会 (huì) means "will / is likely to", and 明天 is tomorrow: it will rain tomorrow.
冷 (lěng) means cold, as in 冬天很冷 — winter is very cold. Hot is 热 (rè).

questions.stem: 北京比上海冷。 What does this sentence mean?
choices: Beijing is as cold as Shanghai.
Beijing and Shanghai are both hot.
questions.explanation: 比 (bǐ) means "than", with the colder place first: 北京 (Beijing) 比 (than) 上海 (Shanghai) 冷 (cold) — Beijing is colder than Shanghai.

questions.stem: 今天三十度。 What does this tell you?
choices: It will be thirty degrees tomorrow.
It is thirty degrees below zero.
questions.explanation: 度 (dù) means degree and 三十 is thirty, so the sentence says it is thirty degrees today. Below zero would need 零下 (língxià).

questions.stem: 春天天气暖和。 What does this mean?
questions.explanation: 暖和 (nuǎnhuo) means warm — mild and pleasant, not hot. Hot would be 热 (rè) and cold would be 冷 (lěng).
雪 (xuě) is snow, so 下雪 (xià xuě) means to snow — snow falling from the sky.
多 (duō) means many and 云 (yún) is cloud, so 多云 (duōyún) means cloudy — literally "many clouds".

questions.stem: Which question asks "Which season do you like the most?"
questions.explanation: 哪个 (nǎ ge) means which, and 最喜欢 is like the most: 你最喜欢哪个季节 asks which season you like most. The last option is only a yes/no question.
风 (fēng) is wind and 刮 (guā) is to blow, so 刮风 means the wind is blowing — a windy day.

questions.stem: 我最喜欢秋天，因为天气不冷也不热。 Why does the speaker like autumn the most?
choices: Because the weather is neither cold nor hot.
Because it often rains in autumn.
questions.explanation: 因为 (yīnwèi) introduces the reason: 天气不冷也不热 — the weather is neither cold nor hot, which is why the speaker likes autumn.
热 (rè) means hot, as in 夏天很热 — summer is very hot. Its opposite is 冷 (lěng, cold).

questions.stem: 伦敦常常下雨，北京冬天会下雪。 According to this sentence, which statement is true?
choices: It often rains in London, and it snows in Beijing in winter.
London is colder than Beijing in winter.
questions.explanation: 伦敦常常下雨 says it often rains in London, and 北京冬天会下雪 says it snows in Beijing in winter — only the second option matches both parts.
